purpose: Screen whether an exact compact-resident up/down layout, without new compression or approximate arithmetic, can provide enough residency to reach 10 tok/s under the current 16GB RAM/page-cache and VRAM constraints.

derived_bounds.method: Linear interpolation between top2048 up/down residency and all-resident up/down decode fallback removal. This is optimistic because it ignores kernel overhead, D2H/scatter/sync, gate-cache loss, workspace, and cgroup refault pressure.

constraint_failures.failure: The optimistic up/down payload needed for 10 tok/s is about 18.69 GiB before gate/model page cache, so it cannot be held in host file cache inside the 16GB cgroup.

constraint_failures.constraint: use VRAM while preserving accepted gate benefit
constraint_failures.failure: The current gate cache is about 13.25 GiB. Adding the optimistic 18.69 GiB exact up/down payload would require about 31.94 GiB before workspace, which is outside the current VRAM budget.

constraint_failures.constraint: do not trade away gate cache for insufficient up/down residency
constraint_failures.failure: The existing nonduplicate allocation model found the best current-cache-budget mix at only 5.612 tok/s. Even dedicating 16 GiB optimistically to up/down gives only about 9.18 tok/s with zero overhead and no gate penalty, which is not acceptable.

decision.reason: A layout-only exact residency design cannot fit enough up/down payload under the 16GB host/page-cache and current VRAM constraints to reach 10 tok/s. It must be paired with a new exact compression scheme, verified approximate/token-stable compute, or a different offload mechanism.

remaining_open_candidates: verified exact/token-stable GPU MXFP4 x Q8_0 path paired with a source/cache solution
new exact compression or packed representation with a measured resident footprint below the current RAM/VRAM budget
combined source overlap plus exact compute/offload that removes near-full decode up/down fallback

next_required_work.before_runtime_code: Write a concrete compute+source design. It must explain how it removes at least 17386.570 ms decode time with less than 1642.887 ms overhead, and it must define fixed-text top1 verification before any strict cold benchmark.
do_not_repeat: top-N exact residency/hotset as primary path
layout-only compact pack without new compression ratio
sacrificing gate cache for an up/down hotset that stays below 10 tok/s
